Qari Arshad HussainIslamic scholar, teacher and radio broadcaster

1910 – 2021 · Maungdaw, Arakan

Also known as Al-Hajj Maulana Mufti Qari Arshad Hussain

ReligionEducationJournalism and media

A Rohingya Islamic scholar, teacher and radio broadcaster from Oudaung Village near Maungdaw, who studied at Darul Uloom Deoband in India and taught at Islamic schools in Myanmar. In 1961 he became the first known Rohingya to recite the Qur'an on the Burma Broadcasting Service, where he also presented news and Qur'anic recitations in the Rohingya language. After fleeing Myanmar following the 2017 military campaign, he kept teaching in Balukhali refugee camp in Bangladesh until his death in 2021.

His story

The Qur'an in a Rohingya voice on Burma's radio

Qari Arshad Hussain was a Rohingya Islamic scholar, teacher, and radio broadcaster. He was born in 1910 in Oudaung Village near Maungdaw and studied Islamic sciences at Darul Uloom Deoband in India from 1939 to 1947. After returning to Myanmar, he taught at several Islamic schools, including Sufia, Lokmania, and Jamiya Forkania.

In 1961, he became the first known Rohingya to recite the Qur'an on Burma's national radio service, the Burma Broadcasting Service. He also presented news and Qur'anic recitations in the Rohingya language. The Rohingya-language program was discontinued in 1965. After fleeing Myanmar following the 2017 military campaign, he continued teaching in Balukhali Rohingya Refugee Camp in Bangladesh until his death in 2021.
